next.reason: 1985: all dimensions of a table may be initialized by a VALUE clause on the entry defining the entire table, and 'lower level entries must not contain VALUE clauses'. 2023: a group-level VALUE is allowed and 'The VALUE clause shall not be specified at subordinate levels within this group' (§2023:13.18.63.3 SR13); 'the group area is initialized without consideration for the individual elementary or group items' (§2023:13.18.63.4 GR5), so every dimension is set. The literal-category limit is a separate VALUE rule. Same effect.
